observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same setup: a white PlayStation 5 Slim console, a black and white DualSense controller, and a stack of five blue game cases.
The console has a visible scratch or dent on the top left corner in both photos.
The controller is placed in front of the console, with the left side (black) and right side (white) visible.
The game cases are stacked vertically; the top case is clearly labeled 'FCPS' with a PEGI 3 rating and 'HYPERION' text at the bottom.
The background is a wooden panel wall, and the surface is a white table with a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DEKINGS MUSICAL'.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
The console appears to be in used condition with some surface wear.
